articles.author: GlobeNewswire
articles.headline: FDA Confirms CardiAMP HF II May Support Premarket Approval of CardiAMP Cell Therapy for Ischemic HFrEF
articles.summary: BioCardia reported FDA meeting minutes indicating a possible path for the CardiAMP HF II trial to support a premarket application. The announcement concerns regulatory guidance and ongoing development, not an FDA marketing approval or a guarantee of trial success.
